Imports

davmethod, auth, davxml

Types

DavClient = ref object
  http*: HttpClient
  base*: string              ## Origin + optional prefix, no trailing slash.
  authHeader*: string        ## Full `Authorization` value, "" when anonymous.
DavClientError = object of CatchableError

                           limit = -1; version = ""): string {....raises: [],

addressbook-query REPORT body. Each entry of filters is a prop-filter on that vCard property; when text is non-empty every prop-filter carries one contains text-match.
